readout_geometry.note: cos > 0: moving along the held-out conflict direction raises z_reject - z_accept

rules.always_reported: REPAIR, FV per arm, RECOGNIZED retention, NATIVE_FV rows, median dA, per group; the readout geometry from the replays: cosine between u_L31 (through the final norm, linearised at each row) and the head's reject - accept query-side direction, per row, MISSED vs BENIGN
rules.arms: per M18 row: replay (no op; bitwise == M18 raw) + PROBE at L19 and L31 x gamma 2 / 4 / 8 + RANDOM at L19 and L31 x gamma 8
rules.consistency_gate: all 620 replay rows bitwise == the M18 raw rows; every op row records |delta h| at the decide token only (other rows' logits equal the replay's bitwise); gamma and direction as planned; otherwise INCONSISTENT
rules.directions: PROBE u_{L,g}: the M18 probe (standardised L2 logistic, C = 1, LBFGS float64, 200 iterations) on the LAST_RESID_L features of all rows outside source group g; u = (w / sd) normalised in raw space; applied only to rows of group g (held out). RANDOM: a unit Gaussian direction seeded by sha256(forward identity), with its own c from the same training BENIGN rows
rules.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: READOUT_GAIN_REPAIRS at L31 (the head's input layer): the conflict feature already present in the missed scenes is causally usable by the pointer head; the miss is an under-weighted readout of a present feature (H-READ, causal at the readout), not a missing representation. At L19 only: usable through the remaining layers. NONSELECTIVE: amplifying the direction pushes benign rows to reject too, so it is not a clean conflict feature for the head. INERT: decodable but not usable along this direction (decodability without use). Level S1-S2 (an artificial intervention on the native action); not a defence: the operation needs the held-out probe, i.e. rule-labelled data
rules.measures: REPAIR(arm) = share of MISSED rows whose action becomes reject_conflict; FV(arm) = share of BENIGN rows whose action becomes reject_conflict, overall and per arm (old, SA, ROUND, OUTSIDER); group-level: number of groups with >= 1 false veto and its Clopper-Pearson one-sided 95% bound; percentile group-bootstrap CIs (10000)
rules.operation: at the <decide> token of the certificate_action row only (other rows and positions untouched), on the residual output of decoder layer L: h' = h + (gamma - 1) * (h . u - c) * u, u a unit direction, c = mean of h . u over the training groups' BENIGN rows (M18 definition); gamma = 1 is the identity
rules.sets: MISSED = new rows whose M18 native action is not reject_conflict (84); RECOGNIZED = new rows that are rejected (40); BENIGN = old / SA / ROUND / OUTSIDER rows not rejected natively (483); NATIVE_FV = the 13 near-miss rows kev-4B already rejects (reported)
rules.verdict_readout: per layer L: READOUT_GAIN_REPAIRS iff for some gamma in {2, 4, 8} PROBE has REPAIR >= 0.5 and FV <= 0.05 on every benign arm, and RANDOM at gamma 8 has REPAIR <= 0.10; READOUT_GAIN_NONSELECTIVE iff some PROBE gamma has REPAIR >= 0.5 but every such gamma has FV > 0.05 on some arm; READOUT_GAIN_INERT iff PROBE REPAIR < 0.5 at every gamma; RANDOM_ALSO_REPAIRS iff RANDOM gamma 8 REPAIR > 0.10 (reported with the verdict)
